newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma says new power plant opened in Rangoon.
newsitem.headline: Burma says new power plant opened in Rangoon.

text.p: A combined cycle power plant has opened at the Thakayta Power Station in the eastern part of the Burmese capital, official media reported on Friday.
The new plant will help boost total power generation at the Thakayta Power Station to 92 megawatts from 57 megawatts, state-run media said.
Burma, faced by a rising power demand as domestic and industrial consumption grow, has been hit by acute electricity shortages over the past few years.

"We are striving to generate enough power to meet the growing demands of new enterprises, heavy industries, towns and villages developed in accord with the market economy," Minister of Energy Khin Maung Thein was quoted as saying.
